program_narrative: Program UTLMNT00 is a batch file-maintenance utility that ends with GOBACK. It opens the control file CONTROL-FILE for input and the output files ARCHIVE-FILE and REPORT-FILE, and clears its counters. The main loop reads CONTROL-FILE until end of file and, for each control record, selects a maintenance function by CTL-FUNCTION: 'ARCHIVE', 'CLEANUP', 'REORG' or 'ANALYZE'. Each function copies the target data-set name CTL-FILE-NAME into WS-VSAM-NAME and then performs three or two step paragraphs (open/archive/close, analyse space/delete old/update catalog, export/delete-define/import, collect statistics/generate report); none of these 11 step paragraphs is present in the program, so the actual maintenance work cannot be traced. Error conditions handled: a failed OPEN of any of the three files and an unrecognised function code; each displays WS-ERROR-MESSAGE (not declared in the program or its copybooks), counts the error and continues, and the program stops with return code 12 only after more than 100 errors.
